brief: The game screen at one tense moment: move 9, you are White against the Medium bot, the snails move after Black's next move, your snail is about to crush Black's bishop and Black's snail is 2 squares from your king.

candidates.name: Garden Patio
candidates.concept: A wet stone patio after rain: the board is the whole stage and you can see exactly where the snails have been and where they'll land next.
candidates.typography: Fraunces 900 for names and the countdown headline (22–26px), Fraunces italic for emphasis, Inter 400/600 at 13–15px for everything else.
traits: Centred board, no sidebar; players sit at opposite corners of the board
Glistening slime trails show each snail's path
Countdown is a three-chamber shell spiral; move log is a ribbon along the bottom

candidates.name: Field Notes
candidates.concept: A naturalist's notebook: the snails are specimens under study, the board is an ink plate and the game is written up as an observation log.
candidates.typography: EB Garamond 600–700 for headings and moves (19–30px), Garamond italic for annotations, IBM Plex Mono 12–13px for coordinates and Latin labels.
traits: Two-page spread: board plate on the left, observation log on the right
Pen-and-ink snails with red-pencil rings and arrows to their next squares
Snail steps are written into the log as italic field notes

candidates.name: Attack of the Immortal Snail
candidates.concept: A 1950s B-movie horror poster: the countdown is the tagline, the board is a tilted stage and the snails are the monsters.
candidates.typography: Bangers at 106px for the tagline and 28px in the starbursts, Oswald 500/700 tracked uppercase for credits, buttons and labels.
traits: Giant tagline counts down to the next snail move
Board tilted in perspective with glowing, oversized snail monsters
Threats shouted in starbursts; move log rolls as the poster credits
